snp2.11:7.4: Ek’agga, reading agga in the sense of ‘gathering place.’
snp2.11:8.1: On the themeless concentration, see MN 121 and SN 41:7.
snp2.11:9.1: At AN 1:148 (1:209) the Buddha cites Ven. Rāhula, his son, as being foremost among the monks in his desire for training.
snp2.11:9.2: vv. 335–342. See also: MN 61; MN 62; MN 147; Thag 4:8.
